description: Infrastructure layer: (T1) Soluções dropdown in AppNavbar, (T2) SolucaoLayout.vue + SolucaoView.vue + index.ts skeleton, (T4) src/router/solucoes.ts with 63 routes, (T5) src/views/Solucoes.vue catalog with ?cat= filter, and (T7) update router/index.ts to mount solucoesRoutes. This FEAT must land before any component FEAT because SolucaoView and solucoesMap are the integration points all later FEATs depend on.
steps: Read src/components/layout/AppNavbar.vue (worktree). Understand current refs (servicesOpen, mobileLinks, serviceDropdown), the dropdown markup pattern, and Transition name='dropdown'. Then modify the file to: (a) Add `const solucoesOpen = ref(false)` and `const isSolucoesActive = computed(() => route.path.startsWith('/solucoes'))` in <script setup>. (b) Add `const solucoesCategories = [ { path: '/solucoes?cat=financas', label: 'Finanças & Saúde', icon: 'mdi:cash-multiple', color: 'bg-emerald-600' }, { path: '/solucoes?cat=marketing', label: 'Marketing', icon: 'mdi:trending-up', color: 'bg-orange-600' }, { path: '/solucoes?cat=dev', label: 'Dev Tools', icon: 'mdi:code-braces', color: 'bg-cyan-600' }, { path: '/solucoes?cat=texto', label: 'Texto & Conteúdo', icon: 'mdi:text-box-outline', color: 'bg-violet-600' }, { path: '/solucoes?cat=design', label: 'Design & Mídia', icon: 'mdi:palette-outline', color: 'bg-pink-600' }, { path: '/solucoes?cat=negocios', label: 'Negócios', icon: 'mdi:briefcase-outline', color: 'bg-yellow-600' } ]`. (c) In the desktop nav, after the Ferramentas RouterLink and before the Institucional RouterLink, insert a new dropdown div with @mouseenter='solucoesOpen=true' @mouseleave='solucoesOpen=false', button with isSolucoesActive class binding, Transition name='dropdown', and a white dropdown card listing solucoesCategories plus a footer link 'Ver todas as soluções →' to '/solucoes'. Mirror the servicesOpen dropdown structure exactly. (d) In mobileLinks array, after the ferramentas entry, add { path: '/solucoes', label: 'Soluções Digitais', icon: 'mdi:rocket-launch-outline', badge: '62 Apps' }.

Create file src/components/solucoes/SolucaoLayout.vue (worktree). Props: name (string, required). Internal state: currentPromo (ref(0)), copied (ref(false)), promoInterval. Promo array identical to ToolWrapper.vue. Methods: nextPromo, prevPromo, copyToolLink (copies window.location.href). Template structure: (1) Breadcrumb bar — div with bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0a1628] via-[#111d3a] to-[#162044], containing breadcrumb nav 'Início > Soluções > name' with RouterLinks and mdi:chevron-right separators, plus share buttons row (same Compartilhar WhatsApp + Copiar Link as ToolWrapper). (2) Promo banner — same bg-gradient-to-r from-accent-500 to-accent-600 with Transition fade/out-in and prev/next buttons. (3) Privacy seal — same bg-emerald-50/70 bar with mdi:shield-check. (4) <slot /> for the tool content. onMounted start interval; onUnmounted clear it.

Route names GeradorGradienteSolucao used to avoid collision with tools.ts GeradorGradiente; AnalisadorTexto/DivisorTexto/ModificadorTexto kept as-is per spec table.
